title: fix(service-settings): Company legal-name help no longer points to an organization name under Branding
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #24987

Clause-②: no

Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The Company page's Legal name help said the legal name "may differ from the organization name set under Branding". That is false since the Branding rework: Branding's `workspace_name` is the product name, and Branding is not offered at all under the `group` and `isolated` postures, while Company is offered on every posture.

- `company.manifest.ts`: the `legal_name` description now reads "Registered legal name of the organization, as it appears on contracts and invoices." The header comment's description of `branding` ("public-facing workspace name / logo / theme") is replaced by what Branding actually offers (product name, logo, accent colour; `single` posture only). Nothing in the file referenced `theme_mode` by name.
- `translations/en.ts`, `zh-CN.ts`, `ja-JP.ts`, `es-ES.ts`: the `legal_name` help carries the same sentence in each locale. These four bundles are hand-written, not generated (`*.generated.ts` does not exist in this package), so they were edited by hand.
- `.changeset/24987-legal-name-help.md`: one `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/service-settings`.

Copy only; no key, value or behaviour changes.

## Verification

- Premise re-checked on current main (123ff6f4e): all five false strings still present, nowhere else in the repo (`git grep` over the English, Chinese, Japanese and Spanish spellings).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` and `typecheck` after building the dependency closure: 57/57 files, 970/970 tests, typecheck exit 0 (head 7aa8df0d8).
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 60 derived families, 58 run with exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met): `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needs a deeper clone (shallow checkout), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a full-repo build. Both are checker-level; CI runs them on a full checkout.

## Acceptance notes

None.
